name: hh-meanrev-micro: chop-gated band fade, low-vol regime (30m)
rationale: MECHANISM: identical regime-first band fade as the 15m variant — fade a bb_z extreme ONLY inside a compressed low-realized-vol range where inventory-managing makers profit fading noise around a stable mid — but on the 30m bar, which trades slower, holds longer, and lets a larger reversion accrue relative to fixed round-trip cost. The timeframe change is economically meaningful: a 30m oscillation clears fee/spread more easily than a 15m one, at the price of fewer events and more overnight regime drift risk. Entry: bb_z below a fitted floor AND vol_realized below a fitted low-vol ceiling. Long-only spot; exit on bb_z reversion. DISCONFIRMER: if the 30m net Sharpe is not distinguishable from the 15m variant after fees, the timeframe axis adds nothing and this is a duplicate — keep the better one. Split by vol quartile: the low-vol quartile must dominate monotonically or the regime gate is fitted, not real — kill.
catalyst: band extreme faded inside a low-vol range on the slower 30m clock
